tldr: InternAgent is a unified closed-loop multi-agent framework for Autonomous Scientific Research (ASR) that automates the entire research cycle from literature-based idea generation through methodology construction to multi-round experimental execution and validation.
contributions: A unified multi-agent framework for diverse scientific research tasks that automates idea generation, idea-to-methodology transformation, experiment execution, and result feedback
Interactive interfaces enabling human-machine collaboration, allowing domain experts to provide feedback during idea generation and across the system
Comprehensive experimental validation across 12 scientific research tasks plus human studies comparing InternAgent's efficiency to human researchers
methods: InternAgent employs a multi-agent system comprising a Survey Agent (literature review and deep research modes using keyword generation and relevance scoring), a Code Review Agent (static analysis via Python's ast module and parallel processing), an Idea Innovation Agent (idea generation with high-temperature LLMs and iterative evolution incorporating critique and literature), an Assessment Agent (multidimensional scoring on coherence, credibility, verifiability, novelty, and alignment with 0-10 scores), and an Orchestration Agent (workflow coordination and human feedback timing). The framework supports two modes of human-interactive feedback: direct human input and automatically generated agent feedback, enabling self-evolving idea refinement.
results: InternAgent was validated across 12 scientific research tasks. In reaction yield prediction, performance improved from a baseline of 24.2% ± 4.2 to 34.8% ± 1.1 in 12 hours (abstract also reports improvement from 27.6% to 35.4%). In enhancer activity prediction, the Pearson correlation coefficient increased from 0.65 to 0.79 in 4 hours. In 2D semantic segmentation, precision advanced from 78.8% to 81.0% in 30 hours. Human studies indicated domain experts found InternAgent's ideas novel and that the system achieved comparable performance improvements in hours that typically require human researchers several months.
limitations: The paper acknowledges that certain technical modules require improvement. Generating proposals that are both effective and novel remains challenging, requiring a balance of creativity and rigor. Closed-loop experimental validation faces hurdles from unexpected variables and noise in real-world experiments. The system's ability to identify research gaps and ensure novelty is constrained by the quality and scope of training data.
